# Settings

Each setting is a key under `settings` in a Browserforce config file. `sf browserforce plugins list` lists them too, without connecting to an org.

| Setting | Config key | Warnings |
| ------- | ---------- | -------- |
| [Account Intelligence View](accountIntelligenceView.md) | `accountIntelligenceView` | prerequisites |
| [Activity Settings](activitySettings.md) | `activitySettings` | irreversible |
| [Auth Providers](authProviders.md) | `authProviders` |  |
| [Call Summaries](callSummaries.md) | `callSummaries` | prerequisites |
| [Company Information](companyInformation.md) | `companyInformation` |  |
| [Customer Portal Settings](customerPortal.md) | `customerPortal` | classic only, irreversible |
| [Density Settings](densitySettings.md) | `densitySettings` |  |
| [Email Deliverability Settings](emailDeliverability.md) | `emailDeliverability` |  |
| [HighVelocitySalesSettings](highVelocitySalesSettings.md) | `highVelocitySalesSettings` | prerequisites |
| [History Tracking](historyTracking.md) | `historyTracking` | prerequisites |
| [Home Page Layouts](homePageLayouts.md) | `homePageLayouts` | classic only |
| [LightningExperienceSettings](lightningExperienceSettings.md) | `lightningExperienceSettings` |  |
| [LinkedIn Sales Navigator Settings](linkedInSalesNavigatorSettings.md) | `linkedInSalesNavigatorSettings` |  |
| [List View Custom Buttons](listViewCustomButtons.md) | `listViewCustomButtons` |  |
| [Omni-Channel Settings](omniChannelSettings.md) | `omniChannelSettings` | prerequisites |
| [OpportunitySplits Settings](opportunitySplits.md) | `opportunitySplits` |  |
| [Permission Sets](permissionSets.md) | `permissionSets` | prerequisites |
| [Picklists](picklists.md) | `picklists` |  |
| [RecordTypes](recordTypes.md) | `recordTypes` |  |
| [RelateContactToMultipleAccounts Settings](relateContactToMultipleAccounts.md) | `relateContactToMultipleAccounts` |  |
| [Reports & Dashboards](reportsAndDashboards.md) | `reportsAndDashboards` | irreversible |
| [SalesforceCpqConfig Settings](salesforceCpqConfig.md) | `salesforceCpqConfig` | irreversible, prerequisites |
| [Security Controls](security.md) | `security` |  |
| [Service Channels](serviceChannels.md) | `serviceChannels` | prerequisites |
| [Slack Apps Setup](slack.md) | `slack` | irreversible |
| [User Access Policies](userAccessPolicies.md) | `userAccessPolicies` | irreversible, prerequisites |

## Removed settings

These settings have been removed, most of them because Salesforce now supports them in the Metadata API.

| Config key | Why | Instructions |
| ---------- | --- | ------------ |
| `communities` | Salesforce now supports this setting in the Metadata API. | [Hall of Fame](../hall-of-fame.md#communities) |
| `deferSharingCalculation` | Salesforce now supports this setting in the Metadata API. | [Hall of Fame](../hall-of-fame.md#defersharingcalculation) |
| `salesforceToSalesforce` | Salesforce to Salesforce has been retired. | [Hall of Fame](../hall-of-fame.md#salesforcetosalesforce) |
| `security.loginAccessPolicies` | Salesforce now supports this setting in the Metadata API. | [Hall of Fame](../hall-of-fame.md#security-loginaccesspolicies-administratorscanloginasanyuser) |
| `security.identityProvider` | Salesforce now supports this setting in the Metadata API. | [Hall of Fame](../hall-of-fame.md#security-identityprovider) |
| `security.sharing` | Salesforce now supports this setting in the Metadata API. | [Hall of Fame](../hall-of-fame.md#security-sharing) |
